decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 26 October 2005 the Certificate of Lawful Development application for a single storey rear extension is inadequate as the annotated dimensions do not match the scale of the drawings and some of the dimensions required have not been annotated. Insufficient details have been given of the front roof extension and the difference in levels at rear.
In the absence of accurate drawings the authority is unable to determine whether the proposals would give rise to a development within the confines of domestic permitted development rights, as defined in the General Permitted Development Order 1995.

Condition : 2 - Informative: You should now either submit a full planning application or apply for a further Certificate of Lawfulness based on accurate detailed drawings. These drawings should be to scale with annotated measurements matching these dimensions. Details of the difference in levels at the rear of the house and the front roof extension over the original porch should also be provided.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a rear conservatory to house
